title: Events page: only a compact toolbar sticks, and Around you is a plain section (LIVE-1219)

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21: the events filters covered half the page and Around you looked broken.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. Two sticky layers (the toolbar and the library bar of tabs, date chips and facet menus) pinned about half the viewport on desktop. Now only the one-row toolbar sticks; the library bar scrolls away, and the Filters button opens at every width (a centered panel from 768px). Around you's tab board reused the class ay-ticker, which members-community.css styles as the Dispatches pill (rounded, centered, glass), so a lone card floated in a blob. It is now ay-board, a plain section with a card grid on desktop and a swipe row on a phone.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const c=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-events.css','utf8');const t=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/events/around-you-live.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(/\.ev-libbar\{position:sticky/.test(c))bad.push('library bar sticks again');if(t.includes('ay-ticker'))bad.push('Around you reuses the Dispatches pill class');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1219: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the library bar sticks again or Around you reuses the Dispatches pill class.
